1251-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2724-6433-8172.description:
Activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling and returning (at end step) itself and Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.
Activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Wormfang Manta and all Auras attached to it.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Flickerform triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield, and then returning all Auras that were attached to Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield attached to Wormfang Manta.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

728-1231-4826-6644.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3899-6351-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

5686-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5686-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2583-4636-5491.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Map token due to Worldwalker Helm.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

225-573-751-3314.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-573-751-3314.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-7686-7764.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
803-7686-7764.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Seton four times by tapping four Squirrels, as they'll be Druids due to Arcane Adaptation, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
803-7686-7764.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped.

4094-4659-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4094-4659-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1976-3532-5078-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1976-3532-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

1274-1939-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1939-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

5670-6291-7452.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

851-1651-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

1409-5419-6753.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1409-1780-2397.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve both Burdened Aerialist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2341-2495-5139.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Relic of Sauron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding two mana in any combination of {U}, {B} and/or {R}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Relic of Sauron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Relic of Sauron and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4785-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4785-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4907-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3054-4050-6967.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6967.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-955-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2933-4013-6753.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1350-1753-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-1753-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-3384-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2438-3384-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1339-2122-4050-4565.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4050-4565.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-3362-3967-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-3967-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1479-5233-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5233-6528.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1029-1253-5028.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Gyre Engineer.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1253-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-5872-6488.notablePrerequisites:
Taii Wakeen does not have summoning sickness.
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying {1} and tapping it, increasing the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn by one.
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-5872-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Taii Wakeen.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Taii Wakeen.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Taii Wakeen.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-5872-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

1636-3641-3821.notablePrerequisites: Distinguished Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3641-3821.description:
Activate Distinguished Conjurer's ability by paying {4}{W} and tapping it, blinking Peregrine Drake.
Peregrine Drake, Distinguished Conjurer, and Intruder Alarm all trigger.
Resolve Distinguished Conjurer's trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Peregrine Drake's trigger, untapping five lands.
Repeat.

151-2085-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
151-2085-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

647-1374-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
647-1374-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

307-344-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Skullsnatcher and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Skullsnatcher or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
307-344-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Skullsnatcher as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Skullsnatcher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1495-3310-4613.notablePrerequisites: War Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3310-4613.description:
Activate War Elemental using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

730-1479-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
730-1479-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Emeria Angel trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
The Bird enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

880-2653-3703.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2529-3363.notablePrerequisites: Vedalken Mastermind does not have summoning sickness.
2529-3363.description:
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

1560-2029-3953-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
1560-2029-3953-4740.description:
Activate Unbridled Growth by sacrificing it.
Mazzy triggers, exiling Unbridled Growth and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Unbridled Growth ability, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Unbridled Growth from exile by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Defiler of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve Unbridled Growth, attaching it to any land you control.
Repeat.
Once you have drawn your deck, you may use the life accumulated to activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal near-infinite damage to any target(s).

292-2584-3938-4245.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal non-lethal damage to Vrondiss.
"Dragons" chosen with Outpost Siege.
292-2584-3938-4245.description:
Deal damage to Vrondiss.
Rite of Passage and Vrondiss trigger.
Resolve the Rite of Passage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Vrondiss.
Resolve the Vrondiss trigger, creating a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
The Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, causing the Dragon Spirit to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
The Dragon Spirit triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The Dragon dies, triggering Outpost Siege, dealing 1 damage to Vronidss.
Repeat from step 2.

1061-3018-3060.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{G}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
1061-3018-3060.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
Rancor attached to any other creature except Timestream Navigator.
1061-3018-3060.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Enigmatic Incarnation triggers, causing you to sacrifice Rancor and then search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it onto the battlefield.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Repeat.
